name: useoz
summary: Budget dialup ISP (National Data & Security Pty Ltd), $16.95 all-you-can-eat dialup (4-hour sessions); ran layer-2 via an On-Ramp 30 to a house in Melton, splitting traffic over a 30m service + squid proxy behind Telstra cable; administrator appointed 2002, ABN cancelled 2012; dialup base acquired by HotKey Internet.

events.details: Administrator appointed 31 Oct 2002; dialup base to HotKey; ABN cancelled 2012.
